Header has 'Số: …/CV-VKS…- …' but the __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ field code appears in body line 'Xét thấy __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ ĐỀ NGHỊ:' — this is a 'Xét thấy' (case context) line, not the document number. The actual Số header has no slot code. Ambiguous mapping. DEFER.

The path 'person.personFullName' may be mis-mapped. DEFER to confirm path/label mapping.

Extracted text: 'Xét thấy ông/bà 5 __PERSON_DATEOFBIRTH__ 6'. The '5' and '6' are footnote markers (annotation numbers from the form's footnote list). The slot sits in a 'Xét thấy' (reasoning) sentence, not a DOB field. No 'Sinh ngày' label visible. DEFER.

Extracted text: 'thông báo cho ông (bà) 5 __PERSON_CURRENTADDRESS__ biết./.'. The '5' is a footnote marker. The slot is in a 'thông báo' (notify) sentence, not a person address field. No 'Nơi ở hiện nay' or similar label visible. DEFER.

Header has 'Số: …/YC/ĐN-VKS…-' but this line does NOT carry the slot. The __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ slot appears in the 'Nơi nhận: - 10 __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ - Lưu:' block — footnote marker '10' followed by slot. The slot is in the Nơi nhận footer, not the document header. No Số/Ký hiệu văn bản label available. Pattern matches BM-075 W2R-029 (body slot). DEFER.

Header has 'Số: …/TB-VKS…-' but this line does NOT carry the slot. The __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ slot appears in body context: '… sẽ tiến hành … đối với __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ Viện kiểm sát 2 … thông báo cho người bào chữa biết'. This is procedural/case reference text, not a document code field. Pattern matches BM-075 W2R-029 (body slot). DEFER.

BM-069 paragraph [017] contains __DOCUMENT_REASONLINE__ on its own line with NO visible Vietnamese label before or after the slot. It is a body-line slot, not a labeled form field. Without a visible label, no label-only approval is safe. Marking DEFER. Same systemic false-body pattern as W2R-029/033/040/013 in closure report §1 (fullDocumentCode is not alone — body procedural text slots without labels follow the same family).

BM-069 paragraph [018] embeds __DOCUMENT_REASONLINE2__ at the END of a procedural sentence about thi hành Quyết định. The slot is sentence-trailing, not preceded by any visible form label. Body/procedural text slot without visible label. Marking DEFER. Note: the 'Lý do' (reason) framing is semantically tempting but the slot is in a thi-hành Quyết định sentence whose grammatical continuation cannot be safely relabeled without re-authoring the source DOCX paragraph.

BM-069 paragraph [031] embeds __DOCUMENT_SUMMARYLINE__ at the end of clause 2 of the biên bản body. The clause enumerates account information (số lượng tài khoản, số tiền có trong tài khoản được hủy bỏ biện pháp phong tỏa tài khoản). The slot is a free-form body completion, not a labeled field. 'Tóm tắt nội dung' would mismatch the procedural context. Marking DEFER — needs path/binding investigation to determine if this is a continuation slot for a labeled account-info enumeration field.

BM-073 has the visible 'Số: …/YC-VKS…-…' header line at paragraph [009] but the slot does NOT sit there. The slot __DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__ appears in paragraph [012] titled 'Thay đổi__DOCUMENT_FULLDOCUMENTCODE__' — a body title line meaning 'Change <code>' (where <code> is the document sub-number being modified). This is the SAME systemic false-header pattern flagged in closure report §1 (W2R-029/033/040/013). Path/binding investigation required before any label can be approved. Marking DEFER.

BM-073 has the visible date header at paragraph [010] ('…, ngày … tháng … năm 20…') but the slot __DOCUMENT_ISSUEDATE__ is NOT on that line. It sits in the body sentence 'Xét thấy__DOCUMENT_ISSUEDATE__' at paragraph [016] — the canonical 'Xét thấy …' (Considering that …) preamble used by procedural/legal Vietnamese forms. This body-line slot is the reasoning clause, not the issuance date header. Labeling it 'Ngày ban hành' would be semantically misleading. Marking DEFER — same systemic body-line-slot pattern as W2R-025 and the closure report §1 family.

legalReviewItems.reason: Body has 'Căn cứ các điều 42, 72 và 78 của Bộ luật Tố tụng hình sự' (legal basis cited in preamble, not a slot). __LEGALBASIS_LEGALBASISLINE__ slot in extracted text is preceded by 'Nơi nhận: 5 __LEGALBASIS_LEGALBASISLINE__ - Lưu:' — this is in the 'Nơi nhận' block. The actual legal basis is in the preamble, not a slot. This is a legal/procedural field; any label change requires legal review.
Original DOC BM-069 places this field in a procedural decision/command context involving Lệnh/Quyết định phong tỏa. Do not approve as 'Số QĐ' without legal review.
